# Vision Managers

> Most businesses are leaking $100K+ a year. Vision Managers finds the leaks, then builds the systems that close them — one person accountable.

Vision Managers (Suk Virk, Seattle's Eastside) works with owners of real, revenue-generating businesses — practices, trades, agencies, recruiting, legal, insurance, coaching, and portfolio operators. The money goes out through missed calls, follow-up that never happens, work still done by hand, and knowledge trapped in one person's head. AI is how the fix gets built; it isn't the point.

## How to work with us (prices as published on the site)

- **The Leak Audit** (free, self-serve): twelve leaks, your numbers, no email required. https://visionmanagers.com/leak-audit
- **Vendor & spend audit** (free to the client): phones, software, AI services re-quoted; the fee comes from the supplier; any setup costs quoted up front.
- **AI Quick-Start** ($500, one week): a 90-minute working session, an opportunity report with dollar math, and one quick win implemented the same week. Guarantee: if the week doesn't end with a written map of your three biggest leaks and what each costs you, you don't pay.
- **Build Sprint** ($1,500–$4,500 fixed): voice agents, bid writers, automation, websites, data systems — every build ships with a monthly recovered-revenue report.
- **Expansion OS** ($7,500, six months, eight seats): build two systems yourself, with guidance. https://visionmanagers.com/expansion-os
- **Strategic AI Partner** ($5,000/month, the only ongoing seat): a weekly strategic block, a named quarterly roadmap, monthly executive readout. https://visionmanagers.com/partner
- **Casual Intelligence** ($79/month founding membership): the weekly roundtable where operators show how they actually use AI. https://visionmanagers.com/ci
- **Book 20 minutes** (free): leave knowing your #1 leak and what it's worth. A working session, not a sales pitch.

## Proven Results

- Bellevue-area eye care practice (unnamed): voice agent live since January 2026, over 700 calls answered so far (about 90 potential patients a month who would otherwise have reached voicemail); 5 appointments in its first 2 days live, $4,300+ in scheduled visit value
- Emerald Health (medical billing, 15+ practices): website rebuild, client interviews turned into video testimonials (one led to a new credentialing contract for Emerald), phone migration off AT&T onto Nextiva signed September 2026 after comparing five carriers
- Phoenix Log (phnxlog.com, Vision Managers' own product): daily log + AI coach rebuilt on its own stack in 11 days; 17 beta testers in the first 11 days
- Sunny Sarah (sunnysarah.net) and My Better Life Mentor (mybetterlifementor.com): website rebuilds handed to the owners with editor access; full case studies at https://visionmanagers.com/lab#case-studies
